title: The AI Diligence Room
subtitle: Buying companies when every seller has an AI story
description: Two hosts work through AI due diligence the way a deal team does it: testing AI claims, looking under the hood at data rights, models, cost and security, running the disruption test, and turning findings into price, contract terms, insurance and a hundred-day plan. Built from public sources; not legal or investment advice.
author: Nadia & Owen
